source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-37

procedures.title: Hard top rear window: remove and install
steps: Removal: take the hard top off the car and cover the headlining to protect it.
Mark where the right-hand upper reveal molding end sits (see figure 69 in the manual), then pry the molding off its retaining clips.
Do the same for the left-hand and the lower reveal moldings.
Take off the lower (inside) garnish molding: remove the 4 nuts on its fixed studs and ease the molding outward.
Remove the glass using steps 8 through 13 of the FRONT END--WINDSHIELD procedure.
Installation: set the new glass in the opening and check how it sits against the flange all the way around.
Make the overlap even all around, at least 3/16 inch.
If needed, put shims under the lower spacers to get the required overlap at the upper and lower flanges.
Once aligned, mark the glass position on the glass and the top surface with a grease pencil.
Install the glass using steps 16-22 of the FRONT END--WINDSHIELD procedure.
Press lightly on the glass so the caulking seats against the opening flanges; paddle the material where needed for a good seal.
Water test right away with a cold water spray; if it leaks, paddle caulking into the leak point from the inside using a flat-blade screwdriver or splint.
Reinstall the moldings removed earlier, working in reverse order.

specs.what: rear window glass overlap on flange (minimum, equal all around)

notes: Caution: while the caulking is still soft, do not aim a heavy stream of water straight at it.
Removal heading and REAR WINDOW title begin on the previous page (1B-36); see figures 67 and 68 in the manual for parts.

procedures.title: Hard top attachments (locks, guides): adjust and remove
steps: Remove the headlining first (see Headlinings).
To shift the left or right lock fore or aft, mark its original position, loosen its 2 mounting bolts and move it the desired way.
Make sure the lock is engaged in its serrations before tightening the mounting screws.
Adjust up or down by turning the hexagonal latch bolts clockwise or counterclockwise respectively.
Header guide pins and rear pin housings come off by removing the mounting screws at their flanges.
To remove the center trim plate, take off the center lock first, then its 4 retaining screws.
notes: See figure 68 in the manual for where the guides and lock mechanisms sit.

procedures.title: Hard top headlining: remove and install
steps: Release the plastic fasteners around the hard top inner panel edge by prying outward carefully with fingers or a flat-blade tool.
If needed, split the removed headlining into its 3 parts by removing the retaining nuts on its inside surface.
To install, line the headlining up with the top before pushing the plastic fasteners in.
notes: See figure 68 in the manual for fastener locations.

procedures.title: Hard top weatherstrip and drip molding: replace
steps: Door window weatherstrip and drip molding are held to the top with screws; remove the screws to replace them.
For side outer or rear outer weatherstrip, remove the 2 end screws, then pull carefully outward at each special plastic clip.
For inner forward weatherstrip, remove its mounting screws and release the special clips along its length.

procedures.title: Hard top vinyl covering: remove
steps: Remove the weatherstrip assemblies.
Remove the reveal moldings.
Before pulling the fabric cover, warm the cemented areas so the edges release more easily.
